novel_features.name: Cross-project service inventory
novel_features.description: List Cloud Run services across multiple GCP projects in a single unified table.
novel_features.rationale: Requires looping List Services across projects and merging client-side -- no single API call spans projects.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use when an agent needs a fleet-wide view of services without multiple separate list calls per project.

novel_features.name: Zombie revision sweeper
novel_features.description: Delete old revisions that are not serving any traffic, keeping only the N most recent.
novel_features.rationale: Requires filtering revisions by traffic-serving status and deleting in bulk -- no single gcloud command does this.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use to free up Cloud Run revision quota without manually identifying and deleting inactive revisions.

novel_features.name: Traffic split inspector
novel_features.description: Show the current traffic split across revisions with image tag and deploy timestamp in one table.
novel_features.rationale: Requires joining Service traffic data with per-revision image info -- two API calls the Console scatters across separate panels.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use when an agent needs to verify which image version is serving what percentage of traffic after a canary deploy.

novel_features.name: Execution outcome summary
novel_features.description: Show a per-execution summary of a Cloud Run Job with succeeded/failed task counts and duration.
novel_features.rationale: Requires List Executions + List Tasks per execution + client-side aggregation -- no single endpoint returns this view.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use as the git log for Cloud Run Jobs to quickly assess whether recent job executions succeeded.

novel_features.name: Public exposure audit
novel_features.description: List all services in a project that are publicly accessible via allUsers or allAuthenticatedUsers IAM bindings.
novel_features.rationale: Requires List Services + Get IAM Policy per service -- a cross-entity query assembled client-side.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use for security posture checks to surface any Cloud Run service unintentionally exposed to the public internet.

novel_features.name: Wait-for-traffic
novel_features.description: Block until a specific revision reaches a target traffic percentage -- a CI/CD gate primitive.
novel_features.rationale: Cloud Run operations complete before traffic shifts; polling trafficStatuses requires a custom loop.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use in CI/CD pipelines after deploying -- prevents running smoke tests before the revision is actually serving traffic.

novel_features.name: Revision config diff
novel_features.description: Show a field-by-field diff between two revisions: image, CPU/memory, scaling config, and env var key names.
novel_features.rationale: Requires two Get Revision calls plus client-side diffing -- not available in Console or gcloud without manual comparison.
novel_features.example: google-cloud-run-pp-cli revisions diff --service my-service --from my-service-00041-abc --to my-service-00042-def --agent
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use during incident triage to see what configuration changed between the last good and first bad revision.

novel_features.name: IAM policy diff
novel_features.description: Compare the current IAM policy of a service against a saved snapshot to detect added or removed bindings.
novel_features.rationale: Requires Get IAM Policy + reading a local snapshot file -- drift detection the API itself cannot provide.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use for compliance audits to confirm no IAM bindings changed since the last approved baseline.

narrative.headline: Every Cloud Run service, job, and revision -- plus a deployment gate, exposure audit, and config diff that gcloud never shipped.
narrative.value_prop: Replaces multi-tab Console sessions and fragile gcloud scripts with a single agent-native CLI. Syncs your entire Cloud Run fleet to a local SQLite store for offline queries, cross-project inventory, and zero-lag CI/CD primitives. Ships the wait-for-traffic gate, public exposure audit, and revision diff workflows that power users have been scripting by hand for years.
narrative.auth_narrative: Cloud Run uses OAuth2 with the cloud-platform scope. Set GOOGLE_CLOUD_RUN_TOKEN to a bearer token from gcloud auth print-access-token. Falls back to Application Default Credentials (ADC) -- run gcloud auth application-default login for automatic refresh.

quickstart.comment: verify config and auth before making API calls
sync your Cloud Run fleet to local SQLite
list services in a project and region
check the last 7 executions of a job

troubleshoots.fix: Run gcloud auth print-access-token and set GOOGLE_CLOUD_RUN_TOKEN, or run gcloud auth application-default login.

troubleshoots.symptom: 404 Not Found on service or job operations
troubleshoots.fix: Check --project and --region flags match where the resource was created.
Increase --timeout; check Cloud Console for stuck traffic migration or a failing health check.

narrative.when_to_use: Use this CLI when managing, deploying, or auditing Google Cloud Run services or jobs. Best for post-deploy verification, CI/CD gates, security posture checks, and cross-project workflows.
anti_triggers: Viewing Cloud Run logs (use gcloud logging or Cloud Logging API directly)
Managing Cloud Run on Anthos or GKE-based environments
Deploying from source code (use gcloud run deploy --source)
